title: PACT: A Decoder-Confidence-Guided Two-Round Receiver for Joint Channel and Phase-Noise Estimation in Sub-THz OFDM
abstract: arXiv:2611.18450v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Frequency-selective fading and oscillator phase noise (PN) jointly impair coded sub-THz OFDM reception. We propose a decoder-confidence-guided two-round receiver combining a {pilot-aware complex transformer} (PACT) estimator, banded linear minimum mean-square error equalization, and neural normalized min-sum decoding. PACT jointly estimates the frequency-domain channel and effective time-domain PN through interacting complex-valued branches. Decoder-derived pseudo-pilots and continuous constellation-aware confidence guide second-round refinement through PACT inputs and attention, with parameters shared across rounds. At $E_b/N_0=30$~dB, the PACT receiver achieves approximately $70\%$ and $57\%$ lower code-block error rates than the best-performing learning-based baseline in the two benchmark settings, respectively. translated_title: PACT：一种解码器置信度引导的两轮接收机，用于亚太赫兹OFDM中信道与相位噪声的联合估计
translated_abstract: 频率选择性衰落和振荡器相位噪声（PN）共同影响编码的亚太赫兹OFDM接收。我们提出了一种解码器置信度引导的两轮接收机，结合了导频感知复数变换器（PACT）估计器、带状线性最小均方误差均衡和神经归一化最小和解码。PACT通过相互作用的复数值分支联合估计频域信道和有效时域相位噪声。解码器导出的伪导频和连续的星座感知置信度通过PACT输入和注意力机制引导第二轮细化，且参数在各轮之间共享。在E_b/N_0=30 dB时，PACT接收机在两个基准设置中分别比性能最好的基于学习的基线降低了约70%和57%的码块错误率。冻结权重测试进一步证明了该方法在不同信道/相位噪声模型、载波频率和FFT/带宽配置下的适用性。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种解码器置信度引导的两轮接收机PACT，利用导频感知复数变换器联合估计信道与相位噪声，在亚太赫兹OFDM系统中将码块错误率显著降低约57%-70%。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes PACT, a decoder-confidence-guided two-round receiver that uses a pilot-aware complex transformer to jointly estimate channel and phase noise, reducing code-block error rates by approximately 57%-70% in sub-THz OFDM systems.
